newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey to spend $31 billion in defence programme.
newsitem.headline: Turkey to spend $31 billion in defence programme.

text.p: Turkey is to spend $31 billion on defence modernisation over the next 10 years, Defence Minister Turhan Tayan said on Friday.
"Thirty-one billion U.S. dollars has been programmed for the Turkish armed forces modernisation," Tayan told a news conference.
The programme announced by the minister included plans to buy more than 100 helicopters and more than 600 armoured vehicles and to construct five frigates.
There were also plans for the modernisation of over 100 F-4 and F-16 planes, as well as the manufacture and modernisation of tanks.
Tayan said it was the first time such a detailed programme had been presented, which in part had the aim of encouraging the domestic defence industry.
Turkey has the second largest number of troops in NATO.
